providers.name: OpenCode Go
providers.notice: Go is intended for coding-agent traffic. Confirm your subscription permits Halation before use. Retention varies by model: GPT and Grok models keep up to 30 days of abuse-monitoring logs, and Claude follows Anthropic's 30-day policy.

providers.name: Claude
providers.notice: Uses separately billed Claude API access from the Claude Console, not a Claude subscription. Anthropic's commercial terms and data retention policy apply. A replacement endpoint must speak the Anthropic Messages API, and its own policies then apply.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.notice: OpenRouter routes requests to model providers. Retention varies by endpoint. Halation requests providers that do not collect data for training, but this is not a zero-retention guarantee.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.notice: Uses separately billed OpenAI API access, not a ChatGPT subscription. Halation disables response storage; provider abuse-monitoring retention can still apply.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.notice: Uses separately billed DeepSeek API access. Vision Exp is experimental. Review DeepSeek's data policy before sending financial text. Images stay on this device; only extracted text is sent.
